subject.title: feat(ui): declutter the Control UI sidebar with customizable pinned nav and a More section

question: Should maintainers accept this pinned-nav and More-section sidebar direction, including the browser-local preference reset, once the concrete code blockers are fixed?
rationale: The implementation is a user-facing navigation redesign that changes default Control UI chrome and persisted browser-local preferences; automation can repair the code blockers but cannot choose the product direction.

options.title: Proceed After Fixes
options.body: Fix the drawer-state and changelog blockers, then land this PR as the selected pinned-nav sidebar direction.

options.title: Narrow To Settings Footer
options.body: Use the smaller path represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100443 and defer pinned navigation.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Redesign
options.body: Pause this PR and decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100386 should own the next sidebar step instead.

recommendation.title: Proceed After Fixes
recommendation.body: Fix the drawer-state and changelog blockers, then land this PR as the selected pinned-nav sidebar direction.
